levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A V2_ file (V1 left as it was), the change at the spot Test 1 broke, highlighted in the screenshot, no red or yellow in the tree.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: V2 exists, but the change is not at the break, or the screenshot does not show which change.

levels.label: Developing
levels.short: Saved over V1, or barely changed
levels.descriptor: V1 was changed instead of a new V2, or nothing visible changed.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No screenshot.

criterion: V2: V2 is its own file, changed at the place Test 1 broke, and shown with the change highlighted

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Five measurements from V2 and a slicer weight, each inside its rule or with its fix.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One measurement or the weight is missing, or one miss has no fix.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Numbers repeat the rules, or two or more are missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No measurements.

criterion: V2: Every dimension and the full-size weight are measured on V2, and V2 is legal or has its fix

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names the place, the amount, and the grams it cost or saved, and where they came from.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The change is clear but the cost is not.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Says it was made stronger, nothing specific.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing written.

criterion: V2: Says what changed and what it cost

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Both split faces show, the fixture is on the small top face only, and the load is 400 lbf pointing down on the small bowl face.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One of the three is on the wrong face, the wrong size, or the wrong way.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two of the three are off, or a screenshot is missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No setup screenshots.

criterion: Simulate: The study is set up right: split faces, fixture on the top face, 400 lbf down on the bowl face

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The hook in blue to red with the color scale beside it.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: No scale, or the whole hook is one color.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No plot.

criterion: Simulate: The stress plot is in, with its color scale

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Picks where the red is and whether it matches Test 1, and the plan adds material at the red and names the blue areas the grams come from.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The red is located, but the plan does not say where the grams come from.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A plan that does not use the plot.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing.

criterion: Simulate: Reads the plot against Test 1 and plans V3 from it
